filesystems.description: List of filesystem entries, each mapping a local path (disk image or block device) to a logical name used in e2tools path specifications (e.g., 'boot.img:/tmp/file'). Each entry must have 'path' and 'name'.

filesystems.items.path.description: Path to the ext2/ext3 filesystem image or block device (e.g., /tmp/boot.img or /dev/sdb1).

filesystems.items.name.description: Logical name used in e2tools commands to refer to this filesystem (e.g., 'boot'). When omitted, e2tools uses the basename of 'path' by default, but explicitly defining it improves clarity.
